measurementContract.technicalReady: HTTP 200, one self-canonical URL, index/follow, one H1, lifecycle answer, no placeholders or temporary copy
measurementContract.upcomingValueReady: teams + series + future schedule; no unsupported prediction copy
measurementContract.liveValueReady: teams + series + verified score or scorecard; record scorecard, performer, or key-event evidence when available
measurementContract.recentValueReady: verified result plus score, scorecard, performer, or key-event evidence when available
measurementContract.discovery: sitemap membership and server-rendered hub-link count; neither is proof of Google indexing
measurementContract.googleState: URL Inspection state when -GscSnapshotPath is supplied; otherwise not-measured
measurementContract.crawlReceipt: GSC lastCrawlTime when available; otherwise pending-gsc-inspection
measurementContract.continuedCrawl: compare GSC last crawl, referring URLs, body fingerprint, impressions and clicks at T+24-72h
measurementContract.valueScoreBoundary: internal heuristic for cohort comparison, not a Google ranking score
